about_the_game:
An Epic almost thirty years in the making...

  • Born in 16-bit in 1996

  • Played by literally some people from every corner of the room we were in

  • Finally perfected for Steam in 2025, making full use of almost all the extra 48 bits

The Easter Bunny Game is an hilarious pick up and play 2-8 player party game packed with bunnies, eggs, bombs, bits of bunnies, shotguns, more bits of bunnies, corks, buckets and carrots!

Grab The Eggs!

Race to gather eggs that rain from the sky and return them to your burrow. Grab a whole stack at once for bonus multipliers! Play in teams or every bunny for themselves.

Play Dirty!

Eggs aren't the only things falling from above. Stuff a bomb down a rival's burrow to halve their score, or cork it to trap them inside - or out. Drown 'em if they're hiding, or blow their head off and steal their load - just watch out; that shotgun has quite a kick! And, of course, ganging up on someone who's doing a little too well is only to be encouraged.

Local Multiplayer and Remote Play Together

Gather round! Two players can share a single controller with up to two more on keyboard, so a full party of eight can play with just three controllers. (FunLittleGames accepts no responsibility for loss or damage to hardware, software, firmware, thumbs, furniture, or relationships as a result of playing this game)

Configure Everything!

Adjust drop rates, round lengths, teams, and victory conditions to suit yourself. The sky is the limit - especially if you're in a burrow when a bomb goes off...

short_description: Grab eggs, bombs and anything else that falls to hand in this frantically stupid multiplayer party game. Perfect for ending quiet nights on the sofa, friendships, or marriages! Absolutely no animals remained intact during the creation of this product.
